observations: Photo 0: a used automatic gearbox of the front-wheel-drive transaxle type, seen from the engine side, lying among other gearboxes in a spare parts shop.
Photo 0: the bell housing is open and the torque converter is fitted; its face is painted blue with small mounting pads.
Photo 0: one driveshaft output with its seal is visible on the left; the aluminium case is dusty and oily but no crack is visible from this angle.
Photo 0: no maker's plate, model code, part number or Toyota mark is readable; the wiring connector whose pin count the seller quotes is not in shot.
Photo 0: overlaid shop watermark ending 'SPARE PARTS'.
No clip of the gearbox being tested, no photo of the pan, fluid or the other side.

identity.kind: used automatic gearbox (front-wheel-drive transaxle with torque converter)

claims.evidence: No Toyota mark, plate or code is readable in photo 0; the shape fits a front-wheel-drive automatic transaxle but does not prove the make.
The electrical connector is not shown in photo 0.
No model code or part number is visible to match against those years.
Origin cannot be proven by a photo; the seller says both Japan and Belgium.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, very strong

claims.evidence: A loose gearbox carries no odometer; mileage cannot be shown remotely.
Case bolts, pan gasket and seals are not shown close up.

risks.risk: The gearbox may not be the Camry unit claimed; a different model or engine fit sets a different price.
risks.proof: Close photo of the model code plate or stamped code on the case and the part number sticker.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced; the gearbox model sets the price

risks.risk: Gearbox may slip, knock or fail to shift.
risks.proof: Clip of the gearbox fitted to a car or test bench shifting through all gears under load, with the seller's handwritten code in shot.

risks.risk: Wrong connector or pin count for the buyer's car.
risks.proof: Close photo of the wiring connector face showing the pins.
risks.if_unproven: as not matching the claimed connector

risks.risk: Opened or rebuilt, burnt fluid or metal in the pan.
risks.proof: Photo of the pan bolts and gasket, and of the fluid drained from the pan or on the dipstick.
risks.if_unproven: as opened and with worn internals

risks.risk: Cracked case or damaged mounts on the unseen side.
risks.proof: Photos of the other side, the top and the underside of the gearbox.

proof_requests: Close photo of the model code plate or stamped code and any part number sticker on the gearbox.
Close photo of the wiring connector face showing the pin count.
Clip of the gearbox tested on a car or bench, shifting through all gears.
Photos of all sides, the pan and the fluid.
A fresh photo with a handwritten note carrying today's date and a code we supply.
response.reason: Photo 0 shows a used automatic front-wheel-drive gearbox, but no make, model code or connector is readable, and the gearbox model sets the price. A photo of the code plate and connector is needed before even a worst case price.
